pt.programme-credo-fullname: Clinical Research Education and Development Online
pt.programme-credo-description:
O Clinical Research During Outbreaks (CREDO) é um programa de treinamento desenvolvido em 2017 em parceria com a Organização Mundial da Saúde (OMS/TDR). Seu objetivo é capacitar pesquisadores de países de baixa e média renda a gerar evidências clínicas de qualidade durante surtos de doenças infecciosas.

O currículo do CREDO está alinhado ao WHO TDR Core Competencies Framework e abrange competências essenciais como pensamento científico, ética em pesquisa, gestão de qualidade e riscos, operações de pesquisa e gestão de estudos e sítios clínicos.

The final workshop and simulation exercise enables participants to put their knowledge into practice in an outbreak scenario. This will help reinforce the learning from e-modules.
pt.programme-credo-who: O treinamento do CREDO é destinado a pesquisadores clínicos e membros-chave de equipes de pesquisa clínica multidisciplinares (clínicos, enfermeiros, gerentes de dados).

pt.programme-fellowship-description:
O ISARIC Leadership Programme for Scientists (ILPS) é um programa transformador desenvolvido para pesquisadores de carreira intermediária de países de baixa e média renda (LMICs) que estão prontos para dar o próximo passo como líderes de pesquisa independentes.

O programa capacita cientistas emergentes com habilidades de liderança, pensamento estratégico e colaboração, essenciais para avançar em suas carreiras de pesquisa e impulsionar mudanças positivas em suas instituições, comunidades e campos científicos.

O ILPS é oferecido por meio de uma combinação de aprendizado autodirigido e elementos interativos, proporcionando uma experiência de desenvolvimento abrangente e adaptada às necessidades dos participantes.

pt.programme-fellowship-cost: Totalmente financiado — bolsa + custos de pesquisa

en.hero-description: Empowering the next generation of South American clinical researchers through structured, accredited programmes.
en.programmes-subtitle: From online self-paced modules to embedded fellowships, our training ecosystem supports researchers at every career stage.
en.programme-credo-fullname: Clinical Research Education and Development Online
en.programme-credo-description:
The Clinical Research During Outbreaks (CREDO) is a training programme developed in 2017 in partnership with the World Health Organization (WHO/TDR). Its goal is to equip researchers from low- and middle-income countries to generate high-quality clinical evidence during infectious disease outbreaks.

The CREDO curriculum is aligned with the WHO TDR Core Competencies Framework and covers essential competencies such as scientific thinking, research ethics, quality and risk management, research operations, and study and site management.

The final workshop and simulation exercise enables participants to put their knowledge into practice in an outbreak scenario. This will help reinforce the learning from e-modules.
en.programme-credo-who: The CREDO training is intended for clinical researchers and key members of multidisciplinary clinical research teams (clinicians, nurses, data managers).
en.programme-credo-apply: Subscribe to our newsletter and receive our updates.
en.programme-fellowship-description:
The ISARIC Leadership Programme for Scientists (ILPS) is a transformative programme designed for mid-career researchers from low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) who are ready to take the next step as independent research leaders.

The programme empowers emerging scientists with leadership, strategic thinking, and collaboration skills, essential for advancing their research careers and driving positive change within their institutions, communities, and scientific fields.

The ILPS is delivered through a combination of self-directed learning and interactive elements, providing a comprehensive development experience tailored to participants' needs.
en.programme-fellowship-who: To participate, candidates must meet specific eligibility criteria. Applications for the programme are open — check the official page for more details on the application process.
en.programme-fellowship-apply: For detailed information on eligibility, timeline, and application, visit the programme's official page on the ISARIC Global website.

El Clinical Research During Outbreaks (CREDO) es un programa de capacitación desarrollado en 2017 en asociación con la Organización Mundial de la Salud (OMS/TDR). Su objetivo es capacitar a investigadores de países de ingresos bajos y medios para generar evidencia clínica de calidad durante brotes de enfermedades infecciosas.

El currículo del CREDO está alineado con el Marco de Competencias Básicas de la OMS/TDR y abarca competencias esenciales como pensamiento científico, ética en investigación, gestión de calidad y riesgos, operaciones de investigación y gestión de estudios y sitios clínicos.

The final workshop and simulation exercise enables participants to put their knowledge into practice in an outbreak scenario. This will help reinforce the learning from e-modules.
